title: A figure whose power is moral confrontation turns into a defensive policy contestant when forced to defend the details
body:
- The disruptive figure focuses on moral clarity, confrontation, and emotional charge without developing detailed policy
- Other aligned actors carry the intellectual discourse, policy papers, and logical argumentation
- This division of labor preserves the disruptor's rhetorical purity and avoids dilution through policy compromise
- The disruptor acts as a lightning rod, concentrating attention and forcing suppressed truths into public discourse
- Policy papers appeal to the intellectual preferences of existing supporters but waste the disruptor's strategic value
- Detailed policy positions create attack surfaces and force the disruptor into defensive explanations aimed at a sympathetic audience
- Without the separation, the disruptor becomes just another policy competitor in conventional political discourse
conversion: a figure's moral-confrontation force turns into defensive policy defense when they are forced into the details
